chapters.title: Two ways
chapters.summary: The Psalms open with two paths. The person who delights in God's law is like a tree planted by water, while the way of the wicked perishes.

chapters.title: The Lord's anointed king
chapters.summary: The nations rage against God and His anointed, but God has set His King on Zion and calls the rulers to serve Him with fear.

chapters.title: A shield about me
chapters.summary: David, fleeing his son Absalom, is surrounded by enemies, yet he lies down and sleeps because the Lord sustains him.

chapters.title: Peace at night
chapters.summary: An evening prayer: God has put more gladness in David's heart than plenty of grain and wine, so he lies down in peace.

chapters.title: A morning prayer
chapters.summary: David prays each morning for God to hear him and lead him in righteousness, and asks Him to defend those who trust Him.

chapters.title: Have mercy on me
chapters.summary: A prayer from someone worn out with sorrow and illness, weeping all night, who then becomes sure God has heard.

chapters.title: God my defense
chapters.summary: Falsely accused, David asks God to judge him by his integrity and to end the evil of the wicked.

chapters.title: What is man?
chapters.summary: Looking at the heavens, David marvels that God cares for mortals and has crowned them with glory to rule over His works.

chapters.title: A refuge for the oppressed
chapters.summary: David praises God for justice and victory: He is a refuge for the oppressed and never forsakes those who seek Him.

chapters.title: Why do you stand far off?
chapters.summary: The psalmist asks why God seems distant while the wicked prey on the poor, then trusts that God sees and hears the humble.

chapters.title: The Lord is in His temple
chapters.summary: Told to flee like a bird, David refuses: the Lord is on His throne and loves righteousness.

chapters.title: Words that are pure
chapters.summary: People speak lies and flattery, but the words of the Lord are pure, like silver refined seven times.

chapters.title: How long, O Lord?
chapters.summary: David asks four times how long God will hide His face, then chooses to trust in His mercy and sing.

chapters.title: The fool says there is no God
chapters.summary: The fool says in his heart there is no God. All have turned aside, but God is with the righteous.

chapters.title: Who may dwell with God?
chapters.summary: Who may live on God's holy hill? The one who walks uprightly, speaks truth, keeps promises and does not harm a neighbor.

chapters.title: The path of life
chapters.summary: God is David's portion and joy. He will not abandon him to the grave, but shows him the path of life and fullness of joy.

chapters.title: The apple of Your eye
chapters.summary: David asks God to hear his just cause and keep him as the apple of His eye under the shadow of His wings.

chapters.title: My rock and fortress
chapters.summary: David praises God who rescued him from his enemies and from Saul: He drew me out of many waters and is my rock.

chapters.title: The heavens declare
chapters.summary: The skies speak of God's glory without words, and God's law is perfect, reviving the soul. David prays that his words and thoughts may please God.

chapters.title: A prayer before battle
chapters.summary: The people pray for their king before battle: some trust in chariots and horses, but we remember the name of the Lord.

chapters.title: The king rejoices
chapters.summary: Thanksgiving for victory: the king rejoices in God's strength and trusts in His steadfast love.

chapters.title: Why have You forsaken me?
chapters.summary: A cry of abandonment: My God, why hast thou forsaken me? The sufferer is mocked and pierced, then turns to praise God before the nations.

chapters.title: The Lord is my shepherd
chapters.summary: The Lord is my shepherd. He leads beside still waters and through the darkest valley, and goodness and mercy follow all my days.

chapters.title: The King of glory
chapters.summary: The earth is the Lord's. Who may ascend His hill? Lift up your heads, O gates, and the King of glory shall come in.

chapters.title: Teach me Your paths
chapters.summary: An alphabet prayer for guidance, forgiveness and rescue, from someone lonely and afflicted who waits on God.

chapters.title: Vindicate me
chapters.summary: David asks God to examine him and declares his love for the house where God's glory dwells.

chapters.title: The Lord is my light
chapters.summary: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? David seeks one thing: to dwell in God's house and behold His beauty.

chapters.title: My strength and shield
chapters.summary: David cries for God to hear him and then blesses Him for answering: the Lord is my strength and my shield.

chapters.title: The voice of the Lord
chapters.summary: A thunderstorm psalm: the voice of the Lord breaks cedars and shakes the wilderness, and He gives strength and peace to His people.

chapters.title: Joy in the morning
chapters.summary: David thanks God for healing: weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. You turned my mourning into dancing.

chapters.title: Into Your hands
chapters.summary: In distress and surrounded by enemies, David commits himself to God: into thine hand I commit my spirit. My times are in Your hand.

chapters.title: The joy of forgiveness
chapters.summary: Blessed is the one whose sin is forgiven. When David kept silent his strength dried up, but when he confessed, God forgave him.

chapters.title: Sing a new song
chapters.summary: Praise the Lord who made the heavens by His word. The eye of the Lord is on those who fear Him and hope in His mercy.

chapters.title: Taste and see
chapters.summary: David praises God after escaping danger: O taste and see that the Lord is good. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted.

chapters.title: Contend for me
chapters.summary: Attacked by people he once helped, David asks God to fight for him and promises to praise Him in the great congregation.

chapters.title: The fountain of life
chapters.summary: The wicked plot evil, but God's love reaches to the heavens: with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

chapters.title: Do not fret
chapters.summary: Do not fret because of evildoers. Trust in the Lord, delight in Him, commit your way to Him, and be still before Him.

chapters.title: A sick man's confession
chapters.summary: In sickness and guilt, deserted by friends, David confesses his sin and asks God not to forsake him.

chapters.title: Life is a breath
chapters.summary: David asks God to show him how fleeting his life is. Every person is but a breath, and his hope is in God.

chapters.title: A new song
chapters.summary: David waited patiently for the Lord, who lifted him out of the pit and put a new song in his mouth. I delight to do Your will.

chapters.title: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor
chapters.summary: God helps those who care for the weak. Sick and betrayed even by a close friend, David asks for mercy.

chapters.title: As the deer pants
chapters.summary: As the deer pants for water, so my soul longs for God. Downcast, the psalmist tells himself: hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him.

chapters.title: Send out Your light
chapters.summary: A prayer to be vindicated and led back to God's altar by His light and truth, again asking, why are you cast down, my soul?

chapters.title: Why do You sleep?
chapters.summary: Israel remembers God's past victories but has been defeated though faithful, and asks God to wake up and help.

chapters.title: A royal wedding song
chapters.summary: A song for the king's wedding, praising his majesty and righteousness: Your throne, O God, is forever.

chapters.title: God is our refuge
chapters.summary: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Though the earth shakes, be still, and know that I am God.

chapters.title: King over all the earth
chapters.summary: Clap your hands, all peoples. God is the great King over all the earth.

chapters.title: The city of God
chapters.summary: Zion, the city of the great King, stands secure because God is in her citadels. This God is our God forever.

chapters.title: Riches cannot redeem
chapters.summary: No one can buy their life from death with wealth, but God will redeem the soul of the faithful from the grave.

chapters.title: God judges His people
chapters.summary: God does not need sacrifices, for every beast is His. He wants thanksgiving, faithfulness and a people who call on Him in trouble.

chapters.title: Create in me a clean heart
chapters.summary: David's prayer after his sin with Bathsheba: have mercy, wash me, create in me a clean heart. God will not despise a broken spirit.

chapters.title: Like a green olive tree
chapters.summary: The boastful trust in wealth and will fall, but David is like a green olive tree in God's house, trusting His mercy.

chapters.title: No one does good
chapters.summary: A version of Psalm 14: the fool says there is no God, but God will restore His people.

chapters.title: God is my helper
chapters.summary: Betrayed to Saul by the Ziphites, David asks God to save him by His name. Behold, God is my helper.

chapters.title: Cast your burden
chapters.summary: Betrayed by a close friend, David wishes he had wings like a dove. Cast your burden on the Lord, and He will sustain you.

chapters.title: When I am afraid
chapters.summary: Seized by the Philistines, David says: when I am afraid I will trust in You. God keeps his tears in a bottle.

chapters.title: In the shadow of Your wings
chapters.summary: Hiding from Saul in a cave, David takes refuge in God's shadow and wakes the dawn with praise.

chapters.title: Corrupt judges
chapters.summary: David condemns unjust rulers and asks God to judge, for there is a God who judges the earth.

chapters.title: My fortress
chapters.summary: As Saul's men watch his house, David waits for God, his strength and fortress, and sings of His mercy each morning.

chapters.title: Help against the enemy
chapters.summary: After a defeat, the people pray for God's help: through God we shall do valiantly.

chapters.title: Lead me to the rock
chapters.summary: From the end of the earth David calls: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

chapters.title: My soul waits for God
chapters.summary: My soul waits in silence for God alone; He is my rock and salvation. Trust Him at all times and pour out your heart.

chapters.title: Thirsting for God
chapters.summary: In the wilderness David thirsts for God: Your lovingkindness is better than life, and I remember You through the night watches.

chapters.title: Hidden from the wicked
chapters.summary: David asks protection from secret plotters, trusting God to turn their own words against them.

chapters.title: God's bounty
chapters.summary: God answers prayer, forgives, calms the seas and waters the earth, crowning the year with His goodness.

chapters.title: Come and see
chapters.summary: All the earth is called to praise God for His works, like the crossing of the sea. He tested His people and brought them to abundance.

chapters.title: That Your way may be known
chapters.summary: God be merciful to us and bless us, so that His way may be known on earth and all nations praise Him.

chapters.title: God arises
chapters.summary: A victory procession: God rides through the deserts, is a father to the fatherless, and carries our burdens daily.

chapters.title: Save me, O God
chapters.summary: Sinking in deep waters and hated without cause, David cries for rescue. Zeal for God's house consumes him.

chapters.title: Make haste to help me
chapters.summary: A short urgent prayer: hurry to help me, Lord, and let all who seek You rejoice.

chapters.title: Do not cast me off in old age
chapters.summary: An older believer who has trusted God since youth asks not to be forsaken in old age and to keep telling of God's deeds.

chapters.title: A prayer for the king
chapters.summary: A prayer that the king will judge with justice, defend the poor and rule from sea to sea, so that all nations are blessed.

chapters.title: Whom have I in heaven?
chapters.summary: Asaph envied the prosperity of the wicked until he went into God's sanctuary and saw their end. Whom have I in heaven but You?

chapters.title: The sanctuary destroyed
chapters.summary: A lament over the ruined temple: remember Your people, O God, and rise up to defend Your cause.

chapters.title: God is the judge
chapters.summary: God says He will judge with equity at the appointed time. He puts down one and lifts up another.

chapters.title: God is known in Judah
chapters.summary: God is glorious and fearsome, shattering weapons of war and saving the humble of the earth.

chapters.title: I remember Your wonders
chapters.summary: In sleepless distress Asaph wonders if God has forgotten mercy, then remembers His wonders of old, leading His people like a flock.

chapters.title: Tell the next generation
chapters.summary: A long retelling of Israel's history, from Egypt to David, so that children will set their hope in God and not forget His works.

chapters.title: Jerusalem in ruins
chapters.summary: The nations have invaded and defiled Jerusalem. The people ask God to help them for the glory of His name.

chapters.title: Restore us
chapters.summary: Israel is like a vine God brought from Egypt, now broken down. Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine.

chapters.title: Open your mouth wide
chapters.summary: A festival call to worship and God's plea: if only My people would listen to Me. I would fill your mouth.

chapters.title: God among the judges
chapters.summary: God judges the rulers who neglect justice: defend the poor and the fatherless.

chapters.title: Enemies conspire
chapters.summary: Nations plot together against Israel. The people ask God to act so that all may know He alone is the Most High.

chapters.title: How lovely is Your dwelling
chapters.summary: How lovely are Your dwelling places. A day in God's courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.

chapters.title: Revive us again
chapters.summary: God once restored His people. Revive us again. Mercy and truth meet together; righteousness and peace kiss.

chapters.title: Teach me Your way
chapters.summary: A poor and needy servant asks God to hear him: teach me Your way and unite my heart to fear Your name.

chapters.title: Born in Zion
chapters.summary: God loves Zion, and peoples from many nations will be counted as born there.

chapters.title: Darkness is my closest friend
chapters.summary: The darkest psalm: a lifelong sufferer cries to God day and night and ends without relief, yet still prays to the God of his salvation.

chapters.title: God's faithfulness to David
chapters.summary: A song of God's covenant love and His promise to David's line, followed by a lament that the promise seems broken.

chapters.title: Teach us to number our days
chapters.summary: Moses' prayer: God is eternal, and our lives are short. Teach us to number our days so we may gain a heart of wisdom.

chapters.title: Under His wings
chapters.summary: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in His shadow. He will cover you with His feathers and give His angels charge over you.

chapters.title: It is good to give thanks
chapters.summary: A Sabbath song: it is good to praise God morning and night. The righteous flourish like the palm tree even in old age.

chapters.title: The Lord reigns
chapters.summary: The Lord reigns, clothed in majesty. He is mightier than the roaring seas.

chapters.title: God of vengeance
chapters.summary: The psalmist asks God to judge the arrogant who crush His people. When anxious thoughts multiply, His comfort delights the soul.

chapters.title: Come, let us worship
chapters.summary: Come, let us sing and kneel before the Lord our Maker. Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.

chapters.title: Sing to the Lord, all the earth
chapters.summary: Declare God's glory among the nations, worship Him in the beauty of holiness, for He comes to judge the earth.

chapters.title: The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice
chapters.summary: Clouds and darkness surround God's throne. Light is sown for the righteous.

chapters.title: A new song for His victory
chapters.summary: Sing a new song, for God has done marvelous things. Let the seas roar and the hills sing together.

chapters.title: He is holy
chapters.summary: The Lord reigns. Moses, Aaron and Samuel called on Him and He answered. Exalt Him, for He is holy.

chapters.title: Enter His gates with thanksgiving
chapters.summary: Make a joyful noise to the Lord. We are His people, the sheep of His pasture. Enter His gates with thanksgiving.

chapters.title: A king's resolve
chapters.summary: David resolves to walk with integrity in his house and to keep the deceitful far from his court.

chapters.title: A prayer of the afflicted
chapters.summary: In loneliness and suffering the psalmist cries out. Heaven and earth will wear out, but God remains the same.

chapters.title: Bless the Lord, O my soul
chapters.summary: Bless the Lord and forget not His benefits. As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our sins.

chapters.title: The Creator's care
chapters.summary: A hymn to God the Creator, who stretches out the heavens, waters the hills, feeds every creature and renews the face of the earth.

chapters.title: Remember His covenant
chapters.summary: Thanksgiving for God's faithfulness to His covenant with Abraham, seen in Joseph, the exodus and the gift of the land.

chapters.title: Israel's unfaithfulness
chapters.summary: Israel's history of forgetting God is confessed, yet He saved them again and again for His name's sake.

chapters.title: Let the redeemed say so
chapters.summary: Four pictures of rescue: wanderers, prisoners, the sick and sailors in a storm all cried out, and God delivered them.

chapters.title: My heart is steadfast
chapters.summary: David awakens the dawn with praise and asks God for help against enemies, since human help is worthless.

chapters.title: Against false accusers
chapters.summary: David prays against those who repay his love with hatred and asks God to help him according to His mercy.

chapters.title: Sit at my right hand
chapters.summary: The Lord says to my lord, sit at My right hand. The king is also a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

chapters.title: The fear of the Lord
chapters.summary: Praise for God's great works and faithful covenant. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

chapters.title: The blessed person
chapters.summary: Blessed is the one who fears God: generous, just and not afraid of bad news, because his heart is steady.

chapters.title: He raises the poor
chapters.summary: God is high above all nations, yet He stoops to lift the poor from the dust and give the barren woman a home.

chapters.title: When Israel went out of Egypt
chapters.summary: At the exodus the sea fled and the mountains skipped like rams before the God of Jacob.

chapters.title: Not unto us
chapters.summary: Not unto us, O Lord, but to Your name give glory. Idols cannot see or speak; trust in the Lord.

chapters.title: I love the Lord
chapters.summary: Rescued from death, the psalmist loves God for hearing him, and will lift the cup of salvation.

chapters.title: Praise Him, all nations
chapters.summary: The shortest psalm: praise the Lord, all nations, for His mercy is great and His truth endures forever.

chapters.title: This is the day
chapters.summary: Thanksgiving for victory: His mercy endures forever. The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is the day the Lord has made.

chapters.title: Your word is a lamp
chapters.summary: The longest psalm, an alphabet poem on God's word in 22 stanzas. Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

chapters.title: A cry in distress
chapters.summary: The first song of ascents: living among people who hate peace, the psalmist calls on God.

chapters.title: My help comes from the Lord
chapters.summary: I lift my eyes to the hills. My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth and never sleeps.

chapters.title: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem
chapters.summary: A pilgrim rejoices to go to the house of the Lord and prays for Jerusalem's peace.

chapters.title: Our eyes look to the Lord
chapters.summary: As servants watch their master's hand, our eyes look to God for mercy.

chapters.title: If the Lord had not been on our side
chapters.summary: Israel would have been swallowed up if God had not been with them. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

chapters.title: Like Mount Zion
chapters.summary: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved; the Lord surrounds His people.

chapters.title: Those who sow in tears
chapters.summary: When God restored Zion it was like a dream. Those who sow in tears will reap with joy.

chapters.title: Unless the Lord builds the house
chapters.summary: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Children are a gift from Him.

chapters.title: Blessed is the one who fears the Lord
chapters.summary: A home blessed by God: work that bears fruit, a fruitful family around the table.

chapters.title: They have not prevailed
chapters.summary: Israel has been afflicted since its youth, but its enemies have not prevailed, for the Lord is righteous.

chapters.title: Out of the depths
chapters.summary: Out of the depths I cry to You. If You kept a record of sins, who could stand? But with You there is forgiveness; I wait for the Lord.

chapters.title: A quiet soul
chapters.summary: David's heart is not proud; he has calmed his soul like a weaned child with its mother.

chapters.title: God's dwelling place
chapters.summary: Remembering David's devotion to find a place for the ark, and God's oath to keep David's line on the throne.

chapters.title: When brothers dwell in unity
chapters.summary: How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity, like precious oil and the dew of Hermon.

chapters.title: Bless the Lord in the night
chapters.summary: The last song of ascents: servants of the Lord who stand in His house by night, lift your hands and bless Him.

chapters.title: Praise the name of the Lord
chapters.summary: Praise God who does whatever He pleases in heaven and earth, who rescued Israel, unlike idols made by human hands.

chapters.title: His mercy endures forever
chapters.summary: A litany of thanks for creation, the exodus and the gift of the land, each line answered: for His mercy endureth forever.

chapters.title: By the rivers of Babylon
chapters.summary: Exiles weep by Babylon's rivers and cannot sing the Lord's song in a foreign land. They vow never to forget Jerusalem, and cry out bitterly against their captors.

chapters.title: With my whole heart
chapters.summary: David gives thanks with his whole heart. God regards the lowly and will fulfill His purpose for him.

chapters.title: You have searched me
chapters.summary: God knows David completely and is present everywhere; he is fearfully and wonderfully made. Search me, O God, and know my heart.

chapters.title: Deliver me from evil men
chapters.summary: David asks protection from violent and slandering people and trusts God to defend the poor.

chapters.title: Set a guard over my mouth
chapters.summary: David asks that his prayer rise like incense and that God keep his mouth and heart from evil.

chapters.title: A prayer from the cave
chapters.summary: Hiding in a cave with no one caring for him, David cries to God: You are my refuge and my portion.

chapters.title: Teach me to do Your will
chapters.summary: David spreads out his hands to God like a thirsty land, asking to hear His love in the morning and be led on level ground.

chapters.title: Blessed be the Lord my rock
chapters.summary: David praises God who trains his hands for battle, and wonders that God cares for mortals who are like a breath.

chapters.title: Great is the Lord
chapters.summary: David's praise: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion, near to all who call on Him in truth.

chapters.title: Do not trust in princes
chapters.summary: Do not trust in rulers who die, but in God who made heaven and earth, feeds the hungry and frees prisoners.

chapters.title: He heals the brokenhearted
chapters.summary: God heals the brokenhearted and counts the stars. He delights in those who fear Him and hope in His mercy.

chapters.title: Let all creation praise
chapters.summary: Heavens, angels, sun, moon, stars, seas, creatures, kings and children: everything is called to praise the Lord.

chapters.title: Sing a new song
chapters.summary: Let God's people rejoice in their King and praise Him with dancing, for He takes pleasure in His people.

chapters.title: Let everything that has breath
chapters.summary: The Psalms end in praise with trumpet, harp, strings and cymbals. Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.
